subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: After the four stale pin assertions are repaired, should OpenClaw accept these 12 updated third-party action revisions as one grouped privileged workflow update?
rationale: The assertion repair is mechanical, but accepting new executable revisions used with credentials and security permissions requires explicit owner judgment because this PR carries the protected security label.

options.title: Approve Grouped Update
options.body: Review the upstream revisions together, require focused guard proof and exact-head CI, then land the repaired group.

options.title: Split Privileged Updates
options.body: Separate token, Docker, CodeQL, and Codex action families for narrower security and operational review.

options.title: Hold Existing Pins
options.body: Pause the batch and retain the currently reviewed revisions until a later dependency-update window.

recommendation.title: Approve Grouped Update
recommendation.body: Review the upstream revisions together, require focused guard proof and exact-head CI, then land the repaired group.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history makes him the strongest person-level routing candidate for the affected workflow and guard surfaces.
